fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Anheuser-Busch Fairfield Brewery, 3101 Busch Dr. Roster coords were ~3.5 km off (movedMeters 3470). Locked center on the main brewhouse/warehouse mass at 38.23550,-122.09050. Identity confirmed by 'THANK YOU TEAM TRAVIS' painted on the warehouse roof (Travis AFB is adjacent) and the brewing complex layout with tank farm and rail yard.
fieldNotes.operatingStatus: IMPORTANT - this brewery permanently CLOSED on Feb 22, 2026 (production realignment; 238 jobs cut). The site is being sold. Audit reflects the physical yard infrastructure as captured in pre-closure imagery; the facility is no longer operating.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled private access road runs ~600 m south from the I-80 frontage road into a fenced industrial campus across an open grass buffer; entrance is a gate-controlled approach. Guard-booth structure not positively confirmed from imagery and Street View has no perimeter coverage - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A guarded entry is standard for an AB brewery of this scale and a small structure sits near the entrance node, but it could not be positively confirmed at z20; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the gate to the dock yard with ample stacking room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Canopied dock banks with backed-in trailers along the N face of the warehouse plus a secondary dock cluster; ~40 estimated, 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer parking rows N of the building hold ~70 trailers; 25-50 band, capacity ~130.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on separate building faces.
fieldNotes.scale: A scale-house-sized structure sits on the truck route near the trailer yard; weigh pad inferred, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multi-track rail yard runs along the S edge with sidings into the property - clearly rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: brewhouse with tank farm, packaging warehouses, ancillary buildings, separate office building, and a large ground-mounted solar farm in the SW.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site between I-80 and farmland on the W; agricultural land borders the W and SW - Rural setting.

citations.claim: AB will permanently close its Fairfield CA brewery; last day of operation Feb 22, 2026, ~238 jobs affected.
Fairfield Budweiser plant to close by February 2026 as part of AB's three-brewery US realignment.

verification.rationale: Closed in the 2025-2026 AB realignment (final operating day Feb 22, 2026); credible dated Tier-2 closure press.
